why: The inert-change failure mode, aimed at the half that is easiest to lose. Issue #917's fix is two pieces in two files, and the stylesheet half is dead on its own: a rule keyed on a class nobody writes matches nothing, paints nothing, and is invisible to every assertion that reads the stylesheet's text. This mutation leaves the CSS rule, the class name and the `classList.toggle` call all present and only stops the condition ever being true -- so the ring silently never appears while `hud.css` still looks correct. It is written as a literal `false` rather than a deleted line deliberately: an empty replacement aborts the whole run, and keeping the call site makes the mutation read as a plausible edit rather than an obvious deletion.
killedBy: pad-navigation focus ring hook (issue #917) marks the root while the gamepad is the settled modality, and not before
hud.css is syntactically whole rings a PAD-driven focus move too, which `:focus-visible` cannot see (issue #917)
